Content-Security-Policy.description: Controls which resources the browser may load and execute.

Strict-Transport-Security.description: Forces HTTPS and helps protect transport security over time.

X-Frame-Options.description: Prevents the page from being embedded in a frame or iframe.

X-Content-Type-Options.description: Prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing a response away from the declared type.

Referrer-Policy.description: Controls how much referrer information is exposed to other origins.

Permissions-Policy.description: Restricts browser features and APIs that a page can use.

cookies.name: sessionid
cookies.notes: Cookie attributes observed from the Set-Cookie response header when present; browser enforcement cannot always be inferred reliably from a single passive response.

notes: Authorization reminder: only inspect targets you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
